name: Freelancer Time Log Pro
author: Fred

sections.description:
Freelancer Time Log Pro is a lightweight time tracking plugin made for freelancers who want to track work fast without leaving wp-admin.

  • Start/Stop timer in the WordPress admin bar
  • Draggable floating timer
  • Stop modal with client + project selection
  • Ticket number + description
  • Per-user entries overview
  • Project totals + client totals
  • CSV export (all, per project, per client)
  • Delete single entries or bulk cleanup

Suggestions or feature requests? Feel free to reach out via https://www.alentejowebdesign.nl/ — if you’d like to see specific improvements or extensions, let me know.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Time Tracker in the admin menu.
  4. Use the Start/Stop button in the admin bar.
sections.faq:
Where are my time entries stored?

Time entries are stored in your WordPress database and are visible per user in wp-admin.

Can I export my time entries?

Yes. You can export CSV for all entries, per project, or per client.
